theorems.name: spoolman_forward_needs_usable_server
theorems.doc: (S) A Spoolman request is handed to the Spoolman client only when a server is configured with an IPv4 host and a port. Upstream hands it over with any host and the client crashes (`Ipv4Address::from_str(..).unwrap()`, found in Renode); rules out the `spoolman_any_host` mutant.
theorems.statement:
theorem spoolman_forward_needs_usable_server (env : Env) (st : DevState) (cmd : DevCmd)
    (hc : cmd = .GetFilaments ∨ cmd = .SetFilament) {w}
    (h : dev_transition env st cmd = ok (w, Outcome.Forward)) :
    st.spool.host_set = true ∧ st.spool.port_set = true ∧ st.spool.host_ipv4 = true
theorems.proof:
theorem spoolman_forward_needs_usable_server (env : Env) (st : DevState) (cmd : DevCmd)
    (hc : cmd = .GetFilaments ∨ cmd = .SetFilament) {w}
    (h : dev_transition env st cmd = ok (w, Outcome.Forward)) :
    st.spool.host_set = true ∧ st.spool.port_set = true ∧ st.spool.host_ipv4 = true := by
  rcases hc with rfl | rfl <;>
    (simp only [dev_transition, spool_usable_val] at h
     revert h
     cases st.spool.host_set <;> cases st.spool.port_set <;> cases st.spool.host_ipv4 <;> simp)

theorems.name: calibrate_needs_client
theorems.doc: (S) A calibration is started only when a client is listening for its result (upstream's 428 otherwise).
theorems.proof:
theorem calibrate_needs_client (env : Env) (st : DevState) {w}
    (h : dev_transition env st .Calibrate = ok (w, Outcome.Forward)) :
    env.client_connected = true := by
  simp only [dev_transition] at h
  revert h; cases env.client_connected <;> simp

theorems.name: info_needs_ready
theorems.doc: (S) The device info is served only once the sensor task has published it; before, the request is refused (503). Upstream unwraps an empty watch and the device resets (found in Renode); rules out the `info_unguarded` mutant.
theorems.proof:
theorem info_needs_ready (env : Env) (st : DevState) {w o}
    (h : dev_transition env st .ReadInfo = ok (w, o)) :
    o = Outcome.Read → env.info_ready = true := by
  simp only [dev_transition] at h
  revert h; cases env.info_ready <;> simp <;> intro _ h <;> subst h <;> simp

theorems.name: wifi_update_resets
theorems.doc: (S) A Wi-Fi update is stored and the device resets to use it (upstream `data_update_save_task`): the reset is always scheduled.
theorems.proof:
theorem wifi_update_resets (env : Env) (st : DevState) {w o}
    (h : dev_transition env st .WriteWifi = ok (w, o)) :
    o = Outcome.PersistThenReset Key.Wifi ∧ ∃ n, w = some n ∧ n.reset_pending = true := by
  simp only [dev_transition] at h
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj (by simpa using h)
  exact ⟨rfl, _, rfl, rfl⟩

theorems.name: updates_keyed
theorems.doc: (S) Every update is stored under its own NVS key: settings under `SET`, RGB multipliers under `RGB`, Wi-Fi credentials under `WF_CR`; no update overwrites another kind.
theorems.statement:
theorem updates_keyed (env : Env) (st : DevState) (sp : Spool) :
    dev_transition env st (.WriteSettings sp) = ok (some { st with spool := sp }, Outcome.Persist Key.Settings) ∧
    dev_transition env st .WriteRgb = ok (none, Outcome.Persist Key.Rgb) ∧
    dev_transition env st .WriteWifi = ok (some { st with reset_pending := true }, Outcome.PersistThenReset Key.Wifi)
theorems.proof:
theorem updates_keyed (env : Env) (st : DevState) (sp : Spool) :
    dev_transition env st (.WriteSettings sp) = ok (some { st with spool := sp }, Outcome.Persist Key.Settings) ∧
    dev_transition env st .WriteRgb = ok (none, Outcome.Persist Key.Rgb) ∧
    dev_transition env st .WriteWifi = ok (some { st with reset_pending := true }, Outcome.PersistThenReset Key.Wifi) := by
  simp [dev_transition]

theorems.name: reads_store_nothing
theorems.doc: (S) Reads store nothing: settings, RGB multipliers and device info are answered without a write set.
theorems.proof:
theorem reads_store_nothing (env : Env) (st : DevState) (cmd : DevCmd)
    (hc : cmd = .ReadSettings ∨ cmd = .ReadRgb ∨ cmd = .ReadInfo) {w o}
    (h : dev_transition env st cmd = ok (w, o)) : w = none := by
  rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp only [dev_transition] at h <;> (try split at h) <;>
    (simp only [ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h; exact h.1.symm)

theorems.name: set_bits_preserves_complement
theorems.doc: (S) Field isolation: writing the `mask` field leaves every bit of a disjoint field `m` unchanged (mutant `set_bits_value_unmasked`).
theorems.statement:
theorem set_bits_preserves_complement (c : Config) (mask value m : Std.U16)
    (hdisj : m &&& mask = 0#u16) :
    ∀ cfg, set_bits c mask value = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& m = c.bits &&& m
theorems.proof:
theorem set_bits_preserves_complement (c : Config) (mask value m : Std.U16)
    (hdisj : m &&& mask = 0#u16) :
    ∀ cfg, set_bits c mask value = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& m = c.bits &&& m := by
  intro cfg h
  rw [set_bits_eq h]
  bvify 16 at hdisj ⊢
  ext i hi
  have h := congrArg (fun x => x[i]) hdisj
  simp only [BitVec.getElem_and, BitVec.getElem_or, BitVec.getElem_not, BitVec.getElem_zero] at h ⊢
  generalize c.bits.bv[i] = a at h ⊢
  generalize mask.bv[i] = b at h ⊢
  generalize value.bv[i] = d at h ⊢
  generalize m.bv[i] = e at h ⊢
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases d <;> cases e <;> simp_all

theorems.name: set_bits_sets_masked
theorems.doc: (C) The `mask` field is set to `value` (restricted to the field).
theorems.statement:
theorem set_bits_sets_masked (c : Config) (mask value : Std.U16) :
    ∀ cfg, set_bits c mask value = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& mask = value &&& mask
theorems.proof:
theorem set_bits_sets_masked (c : Config) (mask value : Std.U16) :
    ∀ cfg, set_bits c mask value = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& mask = value &&& mask := by
  intro cfg h
  rw [set_bits_eq h]
  bvify 16
  ext i hi
  simp only [BitVec.getElem_and, BitVec.getElem_or, BitVec.getElem_not]
  generalize c.bits.bv[i] = a
  generalize mask.bv[i] = b
  generalize value.bv[i] = d
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases d <;> simp

theorems.name: set_gain_preserves_shutdown
theorems.doc: (S) Setting the gain never changes the shutdown bits (mutant `set_gain_wrong_mask`).
theorems.statement:
theorem set_gain_preserves_shutdown (c : Config) (g : Gain) :
    ∀ cfg, set_gain_config c g = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& SHUTDOWN = c.bits &&& SHUTDOWN
theorems.proof:
theorem set_gain_preserves_shutdown (c : Config) (g : Gain) :
    ∀ cfg, set_gain_config c g = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& SHUTDOWN = c.bits &&& SHUTDOWN := by
  intro cfg h
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := set_gain_val c g
  rw [hv] at h
  exact set_bits_preserves_complement c GAIN_MASK v SHUTDOWN TdFree.Spec.shutdown_gain_disjoint cfg h

theorems.proof:
theorem set_it_preserves_shutdown (c : Config) (it : IntegrationTime) :
    ∀ cfg, set_it_config c it = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& SHUTDOWN = c.bits &&& SHUTDOWN := by
  intro cfg h
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := set_it_val c it
  rw [hv] at h
  exact set_bits_preserves_complement c IT_MASK v SHUTDOWN TdFree.Spec.shutdown_it_disjoint cfg h

theorems.name: set_it_preserves_gain
theorems.doc: (S) Setting the integration time never changes the gain.
theorems.statement:
theorem set_it_preserves_gain (c : Config) (it : IntegrationTime) :
    ∀ cfg, set_it_config c it = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& GAIN_MASK = c.bits &&& GAIN_MASK
theorems.proof:
theorem set_it_preserves_gain (c : Config) (it : IntegrationTime) :
    ∀ cfg, set_it_config c it = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& GAIN_MASK = c.bits &&& GAIN_MASK := by

theorems.name: set_gain_preserves_it
theorems.doc: (S) Setting the gain never changes the integration time.
theorems.statement:
theorem set_gain_preserves_it (c : Config) (g : Gain) :
    ∀ cfg, set_gain_config c g = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& IT_MASK = c.bits &&& IT_MASK
theorems.proof:
theorem set_gain_preserves_it (c : Config) (g : Gain) :
    ∀ cfg, set_gain_config c g = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& IT_MASK = c.bits &&& IT_MASK := by
  intro cfg h
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := set_gain_val c g
  rw [hv] at h
  have hdisj : IT_MASK &&& GAIN_MASK = 0#u16 := by unfold IT_MASK GAIN_MASK; decide
  exact set_bits_preserves_complement c GAIN_MASK v IT_MASK hdisj cfg h

theorems.name: enable_clears_shutdown
theorems.doc: (S) `enable` powers the sensor on: both shutdown bits clear.
theorems.statement:
theorem enable_clears_shutdown :
    ∀ cfg, enable_config = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& SHUTDOWN = 0#u16
theorems.proof:
theorem enable_clears_shutdown :
    ∀ cfg, enable_config = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& SHUTDOWN = 0#u16 := by
  intro cfg h
  have hw : with_low ⟨0#u16⟩ SHUTDOWN = ok ⟨0#u16 &&& ~~~SHUTDOWN⟩ := by simp [with_low, lift]
  unfold enable_config config_new at h
  rw [bind_ok, hw, bind_ok, set_bits_val, bind_ok] at h
  rw [set_bits_eq h]
  simp only [SHUTDOWN, IT_MASK, IT_100MS, GAIN_MASK, GAIN_ONE]
  bvify 16

theorems.name: disable_sets_shutdown
theorems.statement:
theorem disable_sets_shutdown :
    ∀ c cfg, disable_config c = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& SD0 = SD0
theorems.proof:
theorem disable_sets_shutdown :
    ∀ c cfg, disable_config c = ok cfg → cfg.bits &&& SD0 = SD0 := by
  intro c cfg h
  have e : cfg.bits = c.bits ||| SD0 := by
    simp only [disable_config, with_high, lift, bind_ok, ok.injEq] at h; rw [← h]
  rw [e]
  bvify 16
  ext i hi
  simp only [BitVec.getElem_and, BitVec.getElem_or]
  generalize c.bits.bv[i] = a
  cases a <;> simp

theorems.proof:

theorems.name: it_mask_collision
theorems.doc: (F) The integration-time encodings overflow `IT_MASK`: `IT_25MS` and `IT_50MS` set bits outside the 3-bit field, so after masking `_50ms` and `_100ms` are the same. Latent: `set_integration_time` is never called.
theorems.proof:
theorem it_mask_collision :
    (IT_50MS &&& IT_MASK = IT_100MS &&& IT_MASK) ∧ (IT_25MS &&& ~~~IT_MASK ≠ 0#u16) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold IT_50MS IT_100MS IT_MASK; decide
  · unfold IT_25MS IT_MASK; decide

dev_transition.lean:
def dev_transition
  (env : Env) (st : DevState) (cmd : DevCmd) :
  Result ((Option DevState) × Outcome)
  := do
  match cmd with
  | DevCmd.ReadSettings => ok (none, Outcome.Read)
  | DevCmd.WriteSettings spool =>
    ok (some { st with spool }, Outcome.Persist Key.Settings)
  | DevCmd.ReadRgb => ok (none, Outcome.Read)
  | DevCmd.WriteRgb => ok (none, Outcome.Persist Key.Rgb)
  | DevCmd.WriteWifi =>
    ok (some { st with reset_pending := true }, Outcome.PersistThenReset
      Key.Wifi)
  | DevCmd.ReadInfo =>
    if env.info_ready
    then ok (none, Outcome.Read)
    else ok (none, Outcome.Refuse NOT_READY)
  | DevCmd.Calibrate =>
    if env.client_connected
    then ok (none, Outcome.Forward)
    else ok (none, Outcome.Refuse NO_CLIENT)
  | DevCmd.GetFilaments =>
    let b ← spool_usable st.spool
    if b
    then ok (none, Outcome.Forward)
    else ok (none, Outcome.Refuse NOT_CONFIGURED)
  | DevCmd.SetFilament =>
    let b ← spool_usable st.spool
    if b
    then ok (none, Outcome.Forward)
    else ok (none, Outcome.Refuse NOT_CONFIGURED)
dev_transition.upstream_note: the config and Spoolman handlers' decisions, with the save task's store/reset folded in

def boot_wifi
  (has_creds : Bool) (connected : Bool) (got_ip : Bool) : Result BootWifi := do
  if has_creds
  then
    if connected
    then if got_ip
         then ok BootWifi.Station
         else ok BootWifi.ForgetAndReset
    else ok BootWifi.ForgetAndReset
  else ok BootWifi.AccessPoint
